sense: a structure that crosses a river or road

pins.definition: A structure built over a river, road, or railway to allow people or vehicles to cross.
A structure built over a river, road, or valley to allow people or vehicles to pass from one side to the other.
A structure built over a river, road, or railway so that people or vehicles can cross.

situation: A lone delivery van drives across a high stone arch spanning a deep, wide river gorge in daylight.
subject: the bridge structure
brief: A steep stone arch spans completely across a wide, rushing river from one green cliff to the other, carrying a small red delivery van right across the middle. The entire structure is rendered as a clean papercraft diorama, showing the clear path high above the water.
prompt: A steep stone arch spans completely across a wide, rushing river from one green cliff to the other, carrying a small red delivery van right across the middle. The entire structure is rendered as a clean papercraft diorama, showing the clear path high above the water. layered cut paper filling the whole frame, real depth between the layers, crisp cast shadows, visibly fibrous card and translucent tissue, raking side light. Never a box, a shadow-box or a picture frame around the scene — the paper IS the world, not an object sitting inside one. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
